statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases within the low band after NQ probed both overnight extremes and retraced each of them, while Stress stays high on a 24-year-high long end and conflicting October Fed pricing.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold on contained, genuinely two-sided overnight NQ structure. The identified danger window spans 12:15Z to 15:30Z, covering the ADP report at 12:15Z, the August PCE release and the Q2 GDP third estimate together at 12:30Z, the 13:30Z US cash open, the 13:45Z Chicago PMI and the 14:30Z EIA crude stocks change. A secondary flow concentration sits at the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction and the Micron fiscal Q4 release that follows the close.
headline: NQ probes both overnight extremes and retraces each, easing Tail to the low band; 24-year-high long yields and split October Fed pricing keep Stress high into the quarter-end PCE and GDP cluster
body:
NQ futures trade near 30,651-30,665, about 0.1-0.2% higher on the session, after visiting both sides of a contained overnight band of roughly 30,540-30,737. Price opened near 30,647-30,657, extended to 30,737 within about 34 points of the 30,770.63 52-week high, retraced roughly 197 points to 30,540, and has since recovered back above its open. Both extremes were probed and both probes retraced, so the session shows no directional efficiency, no shallow-or-absent pullback signature, no repeated extension after failed retracements, and NQ is not holding a session extreme. That two-sided structure is the opposite of the pathological path the Tail score is designed to detect, and it is the reason Tail eases to 15 in the low band with the mapped policy state EA_ON. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed September 29 at 30,339.33, up 0.21%, inside a narrow 30,235.67-30,429.97 range, and VIX sits at 16.04 unchanged, so neither the cash close nor the volatility surface argues for a directional regime.

Stress holds 65 in the high band because the backdrop remains genuinely difficult and, importantly, because the evidence on its main driver is now conflicting rather than simply easing. The 30-year Treasury yield is still near 5.55-5.62%, around its highest since the early 2000s, while the 10-year has eased about 4 basis points to roughly 5.21% from levels last seen in 2007 and the 2-year sits at 4.92%. Pricing for a further Fed increase at the October 28 meeting is dispersed across venues, spanning roughly 47% to 77% depending on the source, after the Committee raised the target range to 3.75-4.00% on September 16. Under this assessment's method, conflicting evidence of that kind raises Stress and trims Confidence rather than lifting Tail, because the long-end repricing still has not transmitted into one-way equity downside. Oil continues to ease, with WTI near $88.7 and Brent near $95.3, both lower on the session, as Saudi pipeline capacity is partly restored, Middle Eastern exports recover toward 98% of pre-war volumes and the United States releases up to 40 million barrels of reserves; that reduces rather than adds to the inflation and geopolitical amplifier, even though the underlying conflict and the Strait of Hormuz disruption are unresolved and rhetoric remains hostile. The overnight macro tone was constructive but dispersed: Australian monthly CPI undershot at 0.4%, Chinese manufacturing and non-manufacturing PMIs returned to expansion at 50.1 and 50.2, the PBoC cut its Pledged Supplementary Lending rate by 25 basis points to 1.50%, and the Nikkei 225 closed the quarter at about 66,795 after a 2.01% session. Third-quarter regional dispersion was extreme, with the KOSPI down 19.05% and the Shanghai Composite down 6.19% against Singapore's 10.42% gain, which is a difficult environment rather than a current NQ path risk.

The horizon is dominated by one dense catalyst cluster on the final session of the third quarter. The ADP September report lands at 12:15Z, then the August PCE price index and the Q2 GDP third estimate print together at 12:30Z, with the September Chicago PMI at 13:45Z straddling the 13:30Z cash open and the EIA weekly crude stocks change at 14:30Z. Consensus looks for core PCE near +0.3% month-on-month and about 3.4% annually, and the BEA publishes its annual national accounts update alongside the release, so recent inflation history may be restated; that revision layer adds interpretation noise and supports the 12:15Z to 15:30Z danger window without implying a direction. A secondary concentration sits at the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction, where month- and quarter-end rebalancing flow is expected to dominate the tape and can distort sector moves, and at the Micron fiscal Q4 release that follows the close with its call near 20:30Z against guidance of about $50 billion of revenue and $31 in adjusted earnings versus consensus near $50.8 billion and $31.5. A semiconductor repricing in thin post-close liquidity remains the most credible overnight gap mechanism. The shared Finviz context was collected at 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z, is therefore more than eight hours beyond the 90-minute freshness threshold, and reported partial coverage with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it carries no weight here beyond confirming a dispersed latest-session megacap and semiconductor tone. No forecast slot reaches the block threshold on current evidence. The named invalidation is a post-release or post-auction path that produces shallow or absent pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding a session extreme, in which case Tail would be reassessed upward on observed structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 06:00Z, published Claude assessments eased steadily from Tail 20 with Stress 79 during the September 29 European morning to Tail 16 with Stress 65 across the final six overnight slots. The September 29 US session produced a narrow Nasdaq-100 range and a modestly higher close even as the long end reached multi-decade highs, and dominant mode migrated through trend-up and trend-down into normal and then mixed as two-sided behaviour reasserted itself overnight. One hour, 14:00Z on September 29, has no published assessment and remains explicitly unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon is shaped by one dense catalyst cluster on the final session of the third quarter. Conditional Tail holds the low band through the European hours, enters the watch band from 12:00Z to 15:00Z as the ADP report, the August PCE release with BEA annual revisions, the Q2 GDP third estimate, the US cash open and the Chicago PMI overlap, peaking at 22 in the cash-open hour, then decays through the US afternoon. A second watch-band lift spans 20:00Z to 21:00Z for the quarter-end closing auction and the post-close Micron fiscal Q4 release and call, before conditional Tail settles at a horizon base of 15 across the Asian session and ticks up once into the October 1 jobless claims and ISM manufacturing cluster. Stress follows the same arc within the elevated and high bands. No slot reaches the block threshold on current evidence. The named invalidation is a post-release or post-auction path with shallow or absent pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding a session extreme.
